summary: Stablecoin Development Corp filed an 8-K reporting amendments to pre-funded warrants originally issued in October 2025, removing exercisability restrictions with two holders, R01 Fund LP and Framework Ventures IV L.P. Each holder exercised on a cashless basis, receiving 11,307,300 shares (net of 24,720 shares withheld as exercise price), for an aggregate issuance of 22,614,600 common shares. Post-exercise, shares outstanding increased to 50,449,780. This is a routine warrant exercise and share issuance, not a special situation. No strategic event, premium, or board recommendation is involved.
